verdict.rationale: Ramp documents its own receipt capture at card swipe and a receipts upload/attach surface in its CLI, and it claims to automate receipt collection. There is no evidence that emailed or uploaded receipts are automatically matched to the correct transaction. The CLI flow is an explicit upload/attach action, not demonstrated auto-matching. Missing for 10: email-forwarding receipt ingestion, documented automatic matching of uploaded receipts to transactions, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can have receipts automatically attached to the right transaction by emailing or uploading them

citations.quote: Auto-receipt capture at the moment of card swipe with AI-filled memos and categories
Ramp automates each step, from collecting receipts to drafting memos.
